_about: Where the site components (assets/models/architecture/site_props.glb) stand at Ascot, in WORLD axes as courses/ascot.json: origin = winning post on the inside rail, x east, z south, y up; the home straight runs along z 0 (inside/far rail) to z 30 (outer/near rail) with the horses running towards -x, and the main stand's front is on z 45.4 (stand on the horses' left). turn = degrees anticlockwise seen from above; 0 = the piece's front faces north (towards the track from the stands side), 180 = it faces south (towards the stands from the far side). An engine places each piece at (x, 0, z) turned by 180 + turn degrees about y (the pieces are modelled with their front facing +z). Edit, add or remove lines to dress the ground.

anchor.note: Re-placed on 3 Nov 2026 for the full course and the 507 m stand: the old enclosures beside the 124 m stand now stand east of the new stand's end (x 405), the far-side enclosure inside the home straight opposite the stand, flags along the near rail.
anchor.carnival: 11 Nov 2026: the festival side re-laid by tools/course/place_festival.py (groups fest_*): balloons at 2f, the big pavilions as the back edge, low planting and small trees in the view file's 'festival'.
